svg.title: It has first moment one and its odd moments three, five and seven vanish. Substitution of the four rational coefficients proves these identities. Taylor expansion therefore reads the ordinary derivative exactly on polynomials of degree at most eight. Physical spacing factors are inserted only when the finite tensor is rescaled. During a stationary descent retain the full tuple (J, Y, E, Q, Ξ), with exact identities X a Jaa = X a ∇aQa, Jab −Jba = X i ∇iΞabi,
